actions.add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a record.

actions.add_field.description: Adds a new field (column) to a table.
actions.add_field.props.choices.descript: Options for a single or multiple select field.

actions.create_record.description: Creates a new record in the specified table.

actions.create_table_by_id.props.solutio: The SmartSuite solution ID (24 characters). Get it from List Solutions.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

actions.find_records.props.maxRecords.de: Stop after this many matches (1-10000). Leave empty to return all matches up to 10000; Has More tells you if more exist.

The member ID. Get it from List Members.

The record ID. Get it from List Records or a create step.
actions.get_record_by_id.props.tableId.d: The SmartSuite table (application) ID. Get it from List Tables.

actions.get_table_schema_by_id.props.tab: The SmartSuite table (application) ID. Get it from List Tables.

actions.list_comments_by_id.props.record: The record ID. Get it from List Records or a create step.

actions.list_deleted_records_by_id.props: The SmartSuite solution ID (24 characters). Get it from List Solutions.

actions.list_records.props.limit.descrip: How many items to return in one call (1-1000, default 100).

actions.list_solutions.description: Lists the solutions (workspaces of tables) your account can access.
actions.list_solutions.props.includeHidd: Also return hidden and system solutions.
actions.list_tables.description: Lists the tables in a solution.
actions.list_tables_by_id.description: Lists the tables in a solution, by solution ID.
actions.list_tables_by_id.props.solution: The SmartSuite solution ID (24 characters). Get it from List Solutions.
actions.list_teams.description: Lists the teams in your SmartSuite workspace.
actions.list_teams.props.limit.descripti: How many items to return in one call (1-1000, default 100).
actions.list_teams.props.offset.descript: How many items to skip. Use the previous offset plus the number of items returned to get the next page.

actions.restore_record.props.recordId.de: A record in the trash of the selected table.
actions.restore_record_by_id.description: Brings a deleted record back from the trash, by table ID and record ID.
actions.restore_record_by_id.props.recor: The record ID. Get it from List Records or a create step.

actions.upload_file.props.file.descripti: The file to upload (up to 100 MB).

actions.upsert_record.props.matchField.d: The field that identifies the record, for example an email or external ID field.

auth.description:
You can obtain API key by navigate to **My Profile->API Key** from top-right corner.
  
  You can obtain Account ID from browser URL.For example, if smartsuite workspace URL is https://app.smartsuite.com/xyz/home, your Account ID is **xyz**.
